name: slider
description: A single-thumb range slider built on a native <input type="range">, so it gets role=slider with aria-valuenow/min/max, full keyboard control (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown) and pointer drag for free. Themed with accent-primary. Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Name it via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

notes: Native <input type="range"> carries role=slider with aria-valuenow/min/max, so assistive tech reads and announces the current value
Full keyboard control is native: arrows step, Home/End jump to min/max, PageUp/PageDown step by a larger amount
Needs an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby); shows a visible focus-visible ring

intents: a single-value range slider (volume, brightness, opacity)
a numeric input adjustable by drag or keyboard
